note: *Tende piedade de mim, Deus*: the bare vocative of every finished psalm, ruled in all four places at once. The familiar incipit has *ó Deus*, option 2 (D44, HANDOFF 23).
*purificai-me … serei purificado … coração puro* keeps the root's echo; *limpar … limpo* would break it at *Cor mundum*. HANDOFF 13 asked you to settle *purificar* against *limpar* before this psalm.
*ficarei mais branco que a neve*, held against two Latinist minors that want the passive kept: *branqueado* is laundry, *alvejado* is heard as "shot at". The *Aspérges* text, settled by D44.
*o vosso espírito santo* in lower case, as the DO Latin prints it and as MS1932 has it; a capital would decide for the Person (D44, HANDOFF 23). *Espírito Santo* is option 2.
*não desprezareis*, not the open row's *desdenhareis*: the Greek is 21:25's *desprezou* (D15's test). It ends the Friday Lauds antiphon. The *desdenhar* row stays open (HANDOFF 23).
